prompt: A company with floating-rate debt wants to convert it to fixed-rate debt using an interest rate swap. The company should enter a swap where it:

options.C: Pays fixed and receives fixed at a different rate.

explanation: The company already pays floating on its existing debt. To convert this to a fixed-rate obligation synthetically, it should enter a swap where it pays fixed and receives floating. The floating received from the swap offsets the floating paid on the debt, leaving a net fixed-rate obligation. Option A (pays floating, receives fixed) would double the floating exposure, not offset it. Option C involves no rate transformation and has no economic purpose. This is the most common interest rate swap application tested on the CFA exam.
